scripts.test: bun test tests/ && bash tests/verify/gate.test.sh && bash tests/verify/hook.test.sh && bash tests/verify/state.test.sh
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run hygiene && bun run test
scripts.card:build: bun build src/card-service/main.ts --target=node --outfile=dist/card/server.js && bun build src/card-service/form/form.ts --target=browser --format=iife --minify --outfile=dist/card/form.js && cp src/card-service/form/form.css dist/card/form.css && bun -e "const c=require('node:crypto'),f=require('node:fs');f.writeFileSync('dist/card/form.js.sha256',c.createHash('sha256').update(f.readFileSync('dist/card/form.js')).digest('hex')+'\n')"
